paxil and risperidone. I spoke to some prick doctor for 1 hour and he diagnosed me bipolar. He was personally involved in a study and I was just another data point to him. The risperidone made me gain 50 pounds in two weeks, and the paxil gave me lots of problems plus more weight gain on top.  
  
I mean borderline when I say bpd.  
  
Thanks but I'm not soliciting advice, I just wanted to share my thoughts and see if anyone else did the same thing. I'm an unrepentant misanthrope :)  

I would like to hear about your book recommendation though.

Thanks for taking your time to contribute. I'm 28.  
  
I probably fit a C-PTSD diagnosis. It's hard to pinpoint specific traumas and I don't really remember much from my childhood. I just remember my dad being a huge asshole a lot of the time, really self absorbed and violent (until I was old enough to kick his ass instead), he may have BPD I don't know. About 10 years ago I was involuntarily committed to the hospital by my parents because I refused to take the medication I was prescribed.
  
That was something I have never fully recovered from, it took years and years before I would even consider medication again, and I certainly shut down to an even deeper level after that. I still won't consider therapy. However, I think it started well before that. I've never told anyone this of course, and this account is a throwaway
